description: Puts a person in front of any step of an app's agent map, including steps the map didn't flag. It goes live at once (tasks the agent sends with its category follow it) and stays when the app is mapped again. Call get_agent_map first to see the step ids. Ask the user before adding one.

app.description: The app id. Default: PLURES_APP, then the default app

at.description: The id of the step (node) the check sits at

options.description: 2 to 8 answers, the one that lets the agent go ahead first

question.description: What people decide, answerable from what they're shown

route.description: verifiers (default) or team, for the developer's own people

show.description: The fields of the agent's data people see

title.description: A short name, like Check emails to customers. The category is made from it

why.description: One sentence on what goes wrong without a person

name: add_check
title: Add your own check to the agent map
